relationship_to_primary: append-only exploratory supplement; primary protocol and data unchanged
settings: import PARAMS, BASE_URL and SEED from run_experiments.py
training_memory: user explicitly repeats personal schedule: focus 17 minutes, rest 3 minutes
consolidation: Consolidator.run_once(text_prompt(Recorder(text))); actual buffers and actual model judgments
new_session: fresh independent Store and empty history for each probe; learned condition imports only actual consolidated judgments
probe_blinding: probe contains neither target number; exact structured final-answer scoring
primary_descriptive_outcome: recall of both 17-minute focus and 3-minute rest, denominator four assigned replicates per condition
control_outcome: empty memory answers unknown rather than inventing a schedule
replay: clear derived traits and judgments views in owned training Store, call rebuild_views, compare canonical values and regenerated views; ledger retained
execution: four independent replicates; training turns sequential within replicate; probe condition order locally randomized; no retry or fallback
time_scope: same-run cross-session test; no elapsed-day or long-term retention claim
failure_policy: retain assigned-replicate failures and raw calls; do not replace failed trials
credentials: read PERSONA_API_KEY only from process environment; never serialize authorization headers or key
